"""Validate numeric fields in a research record against the supplied schema values."""
import json
import math
import sys
from pathlib import Path

record = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
expected = json.loads(sys.argv[2])
assert isinstance(record, dict), "research record must be a JSON object"
for field, value in expected.items():
    actual = record.get(field)
    assert type(actual) in (int, float), f"{field} must be a JSON number"
    assert math.isfinite(actual) and actual == value, f"incorrect {field}"
